name: LighterStatsX
longDescription:
An on-chain trading platform built on Lighter EVM, starting with high-leverage trading against a liquidity pool. The project uses smart contracts as independent resolvers to manage trading logic and settlement transparently.

The long-term vision is to expand into customizable on-chain trading tournaments (1v1, Team vs. Team) and a prop trading model, creating a new layer of trading competition and engagement within the Lighter ecosystem.

The first MVP is already deployed on Lighter EVM Devnet.
